The CAR architecture 106 comprises the CD8 leader sequence, (GGGGS) linker, CD8 hinge region, CD28 107 transmembrane and intramembrane domains, and the CD3ζ signaling domain, all 108 under transcriptional control of the EF1α promoter.
Viral particles were produced in 109 HEK293T cells, with Vpx incorporated during packaging to enhance macrophage 110 transduction efficiency.
